supersedes.reason: independent audit 3 of release-v3 (evidence/release-designs-t076-2026-09-25.md): BF3 (the lens pack was carried as dataset material, the run had no per-arm configurations, digests, order or attempts, and baseline texts could be null at dispatch); lens-effects-v1..v3 are kept unchanged

purpose: G-15 at the critic counterexample-search application point: whether structured micro-lenses change grounded new counterexamples, missed defects and false rejections, compared under identical conditions.

application_point.note: Only this point varies, so only its contribution may be reported.

not_measured.joint_error_change: The verification.md section 8 change in joint (generation-path x critic) error is NOT measured by this design: release-v4 has no generation path, so no generation-path error exists to be linked to a critic miss on the same item. Only critic-side counts are observed; no claim about a lens changing V3 joint errors is made or implied.

precondition: The no_lens critic configuration has a scoped pass under release-v4 on its own sealed set; the arms are then compared on a further sealed effect set.
lens_pack_is_configuration: Every arm's lens pack (or checklist text) is part of that arm's critic configuration: its pack id, version, canonical sha256 and per-rule digests are critic_configuration.lens_refs_and_digests, and the pack is supplied to the harness with the configuration, never read from the sealed bundle. The sealed bundle must not carry a lens pack; the harness and the verifier refuse a case that does. At every counterexample-proposal call the harness checks that the pack actually sent hashes to the arm's lens_refs_and_digests, and the verifier re-checks it from the durable ledger.

dataset.rules: follows qualification_design.dataset of release-v4 in full: must_be_new (including every previously dispatched set), independent authoring, review, storage and access, single_use and attempt_ledger
dataset.disjoint: disjoint from every qualification set and from every earlier lens-effect set
dataset.coverage: cases where each lens's applicability condition holds, cases where it does not (abstention expected), and cases from each boundary class; applicability is judged by the author from the materials, not by the lens author

arms.definition: counterexample-proposal path retained, same max_proposed_chains, lens pack with no rules
arms.text_sha256: null (no text); its critic configuration is the run's critic_configuration

arms.definition: no stronger existing procedure is available for this task; this arm is recorded as identical to no_lens and is not run separately
a generic multi-perspective checklist given the same exploration budget as the lens arms, delivered through the lens-pack channel
arms.text: frozen full text taken from an existing published checklist or written by someone who is not a lens author
arms.text_sha256: required non-null before dispatch and equal to the arm's lens_refs_and_digests.pack_sha256

arms.definition: constructs from actual user work cases
arms.note: no actual user constructs exist; none are invented

arms.text_sha256: required non-null before dispatch and equal to the arm's lens_refs_and_digests.pack_sha256
required non-null before dispatch and equal to the arm's lens_refs_and_digests.pack_sha256
required non-null before dispatch and equal to the arm's lens_refs_and_digests.pack_sha256

pre_dispatch.per_arm: every dispatched arm (no_lens, general_multi_perspective, single_L-P050-01, single_L-P033-02, mix) has its own critic_configuration, critic_configuration_digest, text_sha256 and attempt entry (attempt k and every prior attempt of that arm's configuration digest); arms differ from the run's critic configuration only in lens_refs_and_digests
pre_dispatch.order: arm_case_order lists every (arm, case) pair of the case order exactly once, interleaved per case, fixed before the first dispatch
pre_dispatch.text_digests: non-null text digests are required for general_multi_perspective and every lens arm before dispatch; a manifest with a null digest for one of them does not verify, so the run cannot start while general_multi_perspective is text_not_yet_fixed
pre_dispatch.predictions: predictions_sha256 fixes each lens arm's expected distinguishing questions, where it should apply and abstain on the new materials, and the defects it predicts to surface

single_use: One sealed effect set (effect_set_sha256 = run_identity.sealed_dataset_sha256) is spent by one run that covers all arms: the first dispatched trial of any arm marks the set observed for every arm. No arm is run on the set separately, continued, merged or rerun; each arm's attempt entry is numbered in that arm's own attempt ledger.
held_equal: model, effort, max_tokens, prompt digest, contract, parser, chains and deadlines (checked by the manifest check)
evaluator, verifier, judge and independence profile
case order (randomized once, recorded, same for every arm)

budget.unit: model calls and output tokens per case repetition, plus USD per arm
budget.cap: the same per-arm cap for every arm, fixed in the pre-dispatch manifest; the added input tokens of lens or checklist text are reported, not hidden
budget.stop: an arm that reaches its cap is incomplete for that arm; other arms are not affected

execution: inherits release-v4 execution, pre_dispatch, acceptance.suite_outcome and post_verdict: 3 repetitions per case, no retry, no fallback, concurrency 1. The harness at this commit runs one critic configuration per manifest; a multi-arm dispatcher does not exist yet, so this design cannot execute until one is written, reviewed and pinned in a later version.
measurements: per case and arm: verifier verdict and boundary class
grounded new counterexamples (valid and citing materials) per arm
misses, false rejections and abstentions per arm with real denominators
paired differences of each arm against no_lens on the same case
calls, tokens, spend, wall time and human review burden per arm (a subscription is not cost zero)
information-gain effect (new evidence found) separated from interpretation effect
reporting: observed counts and paired differences with every invalid trial listed; source fidelity, question-trace presence, actual added effect and generalization scope reported separately; no effect, a worse effect or a narrower scope is a valid result
never_claimed: that a lens improves the critic in general
a change in V3 joint errors (not measured: no generation path)
effects at the other two application points
